summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Indexperts Quality Earnings Focused ETF (QIDX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks total return by broadly investing in US stocks of any market capitalization. QIDX was launched on Jan 2, 2025 and is issued by Indexperts.

holdings.infoBox: QIDX is an equity ETF with a total of 132 individual holdings. The top holdings are Arista Networks stock at 4.48%, Thermo Fisher Scientific at 3.40%, Alphabet at 3.22%, Goldman Sachs FS Government Instl at 2.77%, and Apple at 2.41%.
